english:
Collecting an Elemental Pickup matching your Super's element grants 20% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.

Also triggers with <strand Tangles /> on <strand Strand />.

Has a 0.3 second cooldown between triggers.

Does not trigger on Abilities that have at least 1 Charge ready.

Does not work with Acrobat Dodge equipped on <prismatic Prismatic />.

source.text:
Upon picking up a Super-Matching Elemental Pickup:

20% Ability Energy to the least-charged Ability.
Also triggers with Tangles on Strand.

Incurs a 0.3 second cooldown between triggers. 
Does not trigger on Abilities that have at least 1 Charge ready.

Does not work while Acrobat Dodge is equipped on Prismatic.
